scope.goal: Persist a repository-local standing rule that PolyMarket work affecting its running production service or production database uses the least disruptive practical execution mode, with bounded batches instead of a single large atomic mutation by default.
inScope: Root AGENTS.md instructions governing future PolyMarket tasks that can affect the running production service or production database.
Default use of short, bounded, restartable and idempotent batches for production mutations.
Read-only scale/lock/health preview before mutation and health/lock/error checks between batches.
Explicit user approval before using a single large all-or-nothing production mutation when batching cannot preserve the required correctness.
outOfScope: Repositories and projects other than PolyMarket.
Executing or redesigning the currently blocked ETH LossDiff history backfill.
Any production database write, service action, deployment, backup, schema change, or trading action.
A universal fixed batch size that ignores the previewed operation and current production state.
Product source-code behavior beyond the repository-local Codex instruction.
scope.periodOrFilter: Standing rule for future PolyMarket tasks; no historical or production data period is changed by this task.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the existing root AGENTS.md operational rules and confirm the new instruction can be added without weakening existing evidence, approval, parity, or production safety gates.

requirements.text: Add a persistent PolyMarket-only instruction that tasks affecting the running production service or production database must use the least disruptive practical execution mode.
requirements.sourceQuote: выполнять все задачи в максимально щадящем режиме
acceptanceCriteria: Root AGENTS.md contains a clearly titled standing rule scoped to PolyMarket production operations.
The rule prioritizes minimal production load, lock duration and interference even when a gentler execution takes longer.

verification.command: Inspect the scoped AGENTS.md diff and search for the complete gentle-operation rule.
verification.expected: The rule is present once, is explicitly limited to PolyMarket production operations, and does not weaken existing gates.
verification.evidence: Scoped AGENTS.md diff contains one PolyMarket-only standing section and preserves every existing operational, evidence, approval, and parity gate.

requirements.text: Make bounded batch execution the default for non-trivial production mutations instead of one large all-or-nothing transaction.
requirements.sourceQuote: потом я прошу тебя делать порциями
acceptanceCriteria: The rule requires short bounded batches whose size is chosen from a read-only preview and stated before mutation.
Each batch must be independently atomic, idempotent and safely restartable from durable progress.
The operation must stop before subsequent batches when health, errors, locks, affected counts or invariants deviate from the preview.

verification.command: Compare the AGENTS.md batch requirements against REQ-002 acceptance criteria.
verification.expected: Batch sizing, per-batch atomicity, idempotency, restartability and between-batch stop checks are explicit.
verification.evidence: AGENTS.md explicitly requires preview-sized bounded batches, per-batch atomicity/idempotency/restartability, durable progress, between-batch verification, and fail-closed stop behavior.

requirements.text: Require a read-only preview and ongoing production-impact checks around every batch.
requirements.sourceQuote: На большой базе, в момент живой работы сервиса.
acceptanceCriteria: Before mutation, the agent reports exact candidate counts, proposed batch size/count, transaction boundaries, expected lock/load profile and resume marker.
Between batches, the agent checks service heartbeat/errors, waiting locks and actual affected counts before continuing.
Long-running transactions, broad locks, service stop/restart, trigger bypass and similar high-impact methods are not introduced as hidden defaults.

verification.command: Inspect the AGENTS.md preview, monitoring and prohibited-hidden-default language.
verification.expected: The standing instruction makes production impact observable before and during batched execution.
verification.evidence: AGENTS.md requires exact candidate and batch counts, transaction boundaries, lock/load profile, resume point, heartbeat/errors/locks/counts/invariant checks, and forbids hidden high-impact aids.

requirements.text: Do not use a single large all-or-nothing production transaction by default; require a demonstrated correctness need and separate explicit user approval before choosing it over batching.
requirements.sourceQuote: ты каждый раз пытаешься сделать именно так
acceptanceCriteria: The rule states that broad atomicity is not the default for live production work.

If batching cannot preserve a verified invariant, the agent must stop, explain the exact invariant, scale, duration, lock/load impact and alternatives, and obtain explicit user approval before the large transaction.
Technical preference or generic safety language alone cannot justify broad atomicity.

verification.command: Inspect the AGENTS.md exception gate for a single large transaction.
verification.expected: A large all-or-nothing mutation is fail-closed behind evidence and explicit approval.
verification.evidence: AGENTS.md makes broad atomicity non-default and requires demonstrated invariant, scale/impact/recovery/alternative evidence plus explicit user approval.

requirements.text: Limit the standing instruction to PolyMarket.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the PolyMarket repository-local AGENTS.md is changed by the instruction task.
No global Codex instruction or other repository is modified.

verification.command: Inspect changed paths for this task.
verification.expected: The governed implementation path is AGENTS.md only; context/history and this contract may change under workflow rules.
verification.evidence: The only governed implementation hunk is the new section in the PolyMarket root AGENTS.md; no global instruction or other repository was changed.
